title: DFT from WFT
applicability: 1 mil = 25.4 μm. Accuracy depends on correct volume solids data and measurement technique.

title: Theoretical Spread Rate
applicability: Practical spread rate = theoretical × transfer efficiency. Spray: 50–65%, brush/roller: 80–95%, airless spray: 55–70%.

title: Holiday Detection Voltage (NACE SP0188)
equation: V = 1250 × √(DFT in μm) for conductive substrate, brush-type detector

DFT.description: Total dry film thickness of coating

applicability: Maximum voltage must not damage coating. Typical range 2–30 kV. Some standards use V = 525√DFT. Always verify against coating manufacturer recommendation.

title: Dew Point Calculation (Magnus Formula Approximation)
applicability: Surface must be ≥ 3°C above dew point for coating application. Verify with psychrometer or digital hygrometer.

title: Coating Cost per Unit Area
equation: Cost/m² = (material cost/L) / SR_practical + labor cost/m² + equipment cost/m²
applicability: Full lifecycle cost should include surface preparation (often 50–70% of total), inspection, and maintenance recoating intervals.
